RikkiGames - Privacy Policy
Apps Privacy Policy
We gather information on your device and game play experience. This information is shared with third parties and used by ourselves in order to improve the game and enhance your experience. We respect your privacy and will not collect any sensitive personal information. We process this data for the following purposes:
To help identify popular features to know where to focus our efforts
To gather information about any failures or crashes to assist in removing bugs
Deliver ads based on your interests (not in European Economic Area)
Each of our mobile applications has its own specific privacy policy that contains more detail:
